reports.cutoff: BNPB figures cited as of 17:00 WIB, 15 August
reports.description: Child-focused response update: reports over 8,000 children affected by disrupted education and heightened protection risks; sets the earthquake against compounding hazards (El Nino-influenced drought, Mount Lewotobi eruption activity); outlines SCIDN's priority response sectors (child protection, education in emergencies, health and nutrition, MHPSS, WASH) and its partnership with local implementer CIS Timor.
